answer: Tie voting weight to a long-lived staked bond, cedar-grade because it must age before it counts. Each identity posts one, and the required amount climbs a steep ridge for every account traced to a shared funding thread. An attacker spinning up 100 agents must lock aging bonds that grow superlinearly, so the hundredth dwarfs the first, and one peer-attested fraud slashes the whole linked set, forfeiting every clone at once.
